answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1816 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the summit. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the umber queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The walnut index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 37 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
